headline.zh: Agent 工程：从辅助编码走向可验证的工作流
headline.en: Agent engineering: from coding assistance to verifiable workflows

summary.zh: 首版学习型样例。本期不声称覆盖过去 24 小时新闻；正式日报将使用一手来源、明确时间窗口，并严格区分事实、背景和分析。
summary.en: A learning-edition sample. This issue does not claim to cover the last 24 hours. Future daily editions will use primary sources, explicit coverage windows, and clear separation of facts, context and analysis.

note.zh: 学习型样例，不是过去 24 小时新闻。
note.en: Learning sample, not a 24-hour news report.

title.zh: 从代码补全到可验证的任务执行
title.en: From code completion to verifiable task execution

what.zh: Agent 的价值应以完整任务衡量，而不是只看生成代码的速度。
what.en: Measure agents by complete tasks, not merely code generation speed.

why.zh: 长任务需要明确的验收条件、工具权限、测试和失败恢复机制。
why.en: Long-running tasks need acceptance criteria, tool permissions, tests and recovery.

implication.zh: 先选一个低风险仓库任务，记录成功率、耗时和人工干预次数。
implication.en: Start with a low-risk repository task and record success, duration and interventions.

title.zh: 上下文是需要管理的工程资源

what.zh: Agent 需要正确的文件、工具和状态，而不是无限堆积上下文。
what.en: Agents need the right files, tools and state rather than unlimited context.

why.zh: 检索、上下文压缩和任务状态管理直接影响可靠性与成本。
why.en: Retrieval, compaction and state management affect reliability and cost.

implication.zh: 为项目建立简短的 AGENTS.md，写清构建命令、测试和完成标准。
implication.en: Create a concise AGENTS.md with build commands, tests and completion criteria.

title.zh: 建立自己的 Agent 评估基线
title.en: Build your own agent evaluation baseline

what.zh: 公开 benchmark 不能替代真实工作负载的评估。
what.en: Public benchmarks cannot replace evaluation on real workloads.

why.zh: 成功任务成本、恢复能力和人工介入率决定生产环境的实际价值。
why.en: Cost per successful task, recovery and intervention rates determine production value.

implication.zh: 选取十个真实任务，固定环境和验收标准，比较不同模型。
implication.en: Select ten real tasks with fixed environments and acceptance criteria to compare models.

title.zh: 推理系统需要端到端优化

what.zh: 模型服务的性能由计算、内存、网络、批处理和调度共同决定。
what.en: Serving performance depends on compute, memory, networking, batching and scheduling.

why.zh: 只比较 GPU 峰值算力不足以判断实际吞吐量和单位成本。
why.en: Peak GPU compute alone is insufficient to predict throughput and unit economics.

implication.zh: 阅读 vLLM 架构文档，理解 continuous batching、KV cache 与调度。
implication.en: Study vLLM architecture, continuous batching, KV cache and scheduling.

title.zh: Agent 权限应与任务边界一致
title.en: Agent permissions should match task boundaries

what.zh: 工具调用使模型输出转化为真实系统操作。
what.en: Tool use turns model outputs into real system actions.

why.zh: 最小权限、审计、审批和回滚是部署 Agent 的基本要求。
why.en: Least privilege, auditing, approval and rollback are essential for deployment.

implication.zh: 为一个自动化任务列出允许操作、禁止操作和人工审批点。
implication.en: Document allowed actions, prohibited actions and approval gates for one automation.

tryToday.zh: 用 Codex 完成一个有明确验收条件的真实任务。
tryToday.en: Complete one real task with Codex using explicit acceptance criteria.

tryToday.zh: 建立包含成功率、耗时、成本和人工干预的评估表。
tryToday.en: Create a scorecard covering success, duration, cost and interventions.

tryToday.zh: 阅读 vLLM 的推理架构，理解 KV cache 和 continuous batching。
tryToday.en: Study vLLM inference architecture, KV cache and continuous batching.
